name: Firewall Assessment
description: Ability to assess the configuration and effectiveness of network firewalls. Covers firewall rule analysis, ACL review, firewall evasion techniques, egress filtering assessment, stateful inspection testing, and evaluation of next-generation firewall features.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to firewall assessment techniques

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands firewall types, basic rule syntax, and the role of firewalls in network security architecture
evidence: Can explain packet filtering, stateful inspection, and application-layer firewalls
Understands basic firewall rule concepts (allow/deny, source/destination, ports)
Knows common firewall platforms (iptables, pfSense, Palo Alto, Cisco ASA)

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Performs basic firewall assessment tasks under supervision
evidence: Reviews firewall rule sets to identify overly permissive rules under guidance
Uses Nmap firewall evasion techniques (fragmentation, decoy scans) in the lab
Tests egress filtering by probing outbound connectivity on various ports
Documents firewall findings in a structured format under review

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently assesses firewall configurations and identifies security weaknesses
evidence: Performs comprehensive firewall rule analysis identifying risks and redundancies
Tests firewall effectiveness through practical evasion and bypass attempts
Assesses egress filtering and identifies data exfiltration opportunities
Produces actionable firewall assessment reports with prioritized recommendations

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Assesses complex firewall architectures; develops assessment automation; mentors others
evidence: Assesses multi-vendor firewall environments with complex rule sets
Develops automated firewall rule analysis tools and scripts
Identifies subtle rule ordering and implicit allow issues in large rule sets
Mentors junior staff on firewall assessment methodology

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines firewall assessment methodology; deep platform expertise; trains teams
evidence: Authored the lab's firewall assessment standard methodology
Deep expertise across multiple firewall platforms and NGFW features
Published research on firewall evasion or assessment techniques
Trains teams on firewall assessment and secure configuration review

assessment_methods.description: Assess a lab firewall configuration and produce a report identifying all security weaknesses, misconfigurations, and evasion opportunities
Review firewall assessment reports from recent engagements for thoroughness and quality of recommendations
